summary: Hydro One Limited filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) for the month of May 2026, attaching its Q1 2026 earnings release. The filing discloses planned CEO transition: David Lebeter retires as President and CEO effective June 9, 2026, and remains Special Advisor until October 10, 2026; Megan Telford, COO, appointed President and CEO effective same date. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. Routine management succession and earnings results without forced departure or structural change. Not a special situation.
